historical_pattern.summary: MST-wi representation: a filename prefix plus ../../ must not grant a file the public path does not.

entrypoints: HTTP file query with a nested parent sequence

invariant: A path that starts with a public filename and then walks upward must not return bytes from outside the authorized data root.
attacker_capabilities: can insert parent-directory segments after a filename

oracle.success_means: nested parent segments returned a secret from outside the data root

severity_rationale: Stripping only a leading ../ leaves a later parent walk as an incomplete path fix.
